info.title: The words of the plugin-hostd protocol

PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_REPLY_CODES.description: The refusals only plugin-hostd answers by number (include/plugin-hostd/protocol.h PHD_ERRORS), and the curve verbs' own, which any host that registers them through this library answers. The numbers it answers in common with omx-clap-host are the domain host's HOST_REPLY_CODES.

oneOf.title: placementInvalid
oneOf.description: not a placement, or not valid here
oneOf.x-text: The plugin cannot be placed there; choose another place for it.

oneOf.title: noBackend
oneOf.description: no worker program for the scheme
oneOf.x-text: No installed program can run this kind of plugin; install one, or choose a plugin of another kind.

oneOf.title: workerSpawn
oneOf.description: the worker is not up
oneOf.x-text: The program that runs the plugin is not running; wait a moment and try again.

oneOf.title: replay
oneOf.description: the name of a refused replay on stderr, never a reply
oneOf.x-text: A plugin could not be put back after a restart and was left out; add it again.

oneOf.title: gaveUp
oneOf.description: the storm bound is spent for that placement
oneOf.x-text: The plugin kept failing and was given up on; check it, then add it again.

oneOf.title: noSuchWorker
oneOf.description: no such worker
oneOf.x-text: No plugin host with that name is running; refresh the list and choose another.

oneOf.title: verbDropped
oneOf.description: the worker died on this very command and the daemon dropped it
oneOf.x-text: The plugin stopped just as it was asked to do this, so the request was lost; try again.

oneOf.title: pinBinaryMismatch
oneOf.description: a pinned file is missing or its SHA-256 differs
oneOf.x-text: The plugin's files are not the ones that were approved; install the approved version, or approve this one.

oneOf.title: lv2AdapterRefused
oneOf.description: the lv2-clap worker's LV2 adapter cannot run this plugin
oneOf.x-text: This LV2 plugin cannot run here because the adapter does not support something it needs; choose another plugin.

oneOf.title: noPresetList
oneOf.description: the instance's worker cannot list the plugin's presets
oneOf.x-text: This plugin cannot list its presets; load one by name, or choose one of your own.

oneOf.title: pinRefused
oneOf.description: the plugin's pin carries verdict=refused
oneOf.x-text: This plugin failed its checks and is blocked; only you can allow it, by approving the plugin.

oneOf.title: chainUnknownInstance
oneOf.description: a member is an instance no add made
oneOf.x-text: The chain includes a plugin that was never added; add it first, or take it out of the chain.

oneOf.title: chainDuplicate
oneOf.description: an instance is named twice in one chain
oneOf.x-text: The chain includes the same plugin twice; keep it only once.

oneOf.title: chainInstanceBusy
oneOf.description: a member is already in another chain
oneOf.x-text: A plugin in this chain is already in another chain; clear that chain first, or use another plugin.

oneOf.title: chainMixedFormat
oneOf.description: no one worker program runs every member
oneOf.x-text: These plugins cannot run together as one chain because no single program can host them all; split the chain.

oneOf.title: noSuchChain
oneOf.description: a chain no chain line declared
oneOf.x-text: There is no such chain; declare it first, or choose one that exists.

oneOf.title: presetNotOffered
oneOf.description: a stable name the plugin does not offer
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has no preset with that name; choose one from its list.

oneOf.title: presetInvalid
oneOf.description: a preset file or path that is not the preset format
oneOf.x-text: The preset file cannot be used because it is unreadable or not in the preset format; choose another file, or save the preset again.

oneOf.title: presetNeedsState
oneOf.description: a preset file that carries state for a worker that cannot take state
oneOf.x-text: This preset holds the plugin's saved state, which this plugin host cannot load yet; use a preset made by the plugin itself.

oneOf.title: presetPluginChanged
oneOf.description: the preset file's plugin id, version or fingerprint is not the instance's
oneOf.x-text: The preset was made for another plugin, or another version of it, so nothing was applied; choose a preset made for this one.

oneOf.title: loadRefused
oneOf.description: the plugin refused the preset or the state its file carries
oneOf.x-text: The plugin did not accept the contents of the preset; try another preset.

oneOf.title: presetNotApplied
oneOf.description: the plugin took the preset, and had not run once since, so had not applied it, when the host's wait for that ran out: its values may still be the previous ones
oneOf.x-text: The plugin took the preset but had not applied it yet when the wait ran out; read its values again, or load the preset again.

oneOf.title: labelInvalid
oneOf.description: node_label's label is longer than PHD_NODE_LABEL_MAX bytes or is not UTF-8: the node keeps the label it had
oneOf.x-text: That label is too long or not valid text, so the node keeps its previous name; use at most 64 bytes of UTF-8 text.

oneOf.title: dirNotWritable
oneOf.description: descriptor_dir cannot be made or written
oneOf.x-text: A folder the plugins need cannot be created or written to; check its location and permissions.

oneOf.title: descriptorAbsent
oneOf.description: no descriptor (panel) for the plugin's binary as it is now; of description_get, no layer of the descriptions store holds the plugin
oneOf.x-text: There is no description of this plugin yet, so its panel cannot be shown; add the plugin again so it is scanned and described.

oneOf.title: descriptorPending
oneOf.description: the scan its add started has not written the descriptor (panel) yet; of description_get, the plugin's ask still runs
oneOf.x-text: The plugin is still being scanned or described; try again in a moment.

oneOf.title: descriptorScanFailed
oneOf.description: the plugin's last scan wrote no descriptor (panel)
oneOf.x-text: The plugin could not be scanned, so its panel is not available; check that it works, then add it again.

oneOf.title: noSuchPlan
oneOf.description: a chain no plan verb planned
oneOf.x-text: There is no plan for this chain; make one first.

oneOf.title: noRecord
oneOf.description: no qualification record names the plugin
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has not been measured yet, so its cost is not known; run its qualification first.

oneOf.title: noCell
oneOf.description: the plugin's qualification records hold no cost and latency at that rate and quantum
oneOf.x-text: This plugin has no measurement at this sample rate and block size; measure it with these settings, or change them.

oneOf.title: unknownPlugin
oneOf.description: the uri names no plugin installed here
oneOf.x-text: No plugin with that address is installed here; install it, or choose another.

oneOf.title: curveKindUnknown
oneOf.description: curve_bind of a family the display's kind is not drawn for (an eq_response is the eq family's, a time_response the delay's or the reverb's, a transfer_curve every other's), or curve_points of a binding whose values pick a band shape, a head filter slope, a reverb algorithm or a delay division with no closed form
oneOf.x-text: This curve cannot be drawn for that kind of plugin or for the shape or slope it is set to; choose another shape or slope.

oneOf.title: curveTermMissing
oneOf.description: curve_points of a display with no binding, or of a binding that lacks a term the model needs
oneOf.x-text: The curve has nothing bound to draw from yet; bind the display to the plugin's controls first.

oneOf.title: curveUnitRefused
oneOf.description: curve_bind of a term in a unit its role does not take
oneOf.x-text: A control was bound in a unit that part of the curve does not take; bind it in the unit that part expects.

oneOf.title: curvePointsRange
oneOf.description: curve_points of fewer than 2 points or more than the most a curve carries, an EQ's three anchors a drawn band counted, or of a band index past what fits
oneOf.x-text: The curve was asked for too few or too many points, or for a band that is not there; ask for fewer points or another band.

oneOf.title: durableWriteFailed
oneOf.description: the daemon's write of a file the verb changes (the history, a pin file) failed on its writer thread: the change is not on disk
oneOf.x-text: The change could not be saved to disk, so it will not be there after a restart; check the free space and try again.

oneOf.title: writerQueueFull
oneOf.description: the daemon's writer queue holds its most writes (64) or bytes (64 MiB): the write the verb needs was refused, and nothing of it changed
oneOf.x-text: Too many changes are waiting to be saved, so this one was not made; wait a moment and try again.

oneOf.title: curveValueNotFinite
oneOf.description: curve_points of a binding whose value, as the instance holds it, is not finite, or of an instance that runs at no rate: no curve is drawn
oneOf.x-text: The curve cannot be drawn because a value of the plugin is not a number, or the plugin is not running; start it or set the value again.

oneOf.title: outputNotMonitored
oneOf.description: monitor_output_off of an output this connection did not monitor: a monitor ends with the connection that set it, and only that connection ends it earlier
oneOf.x-text: That output is not being watched on this connection, so there is nothing to stop.

PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_DAEMON_VERBS.description: The verbs plugin-hostd adds to mod-host's protocol and answers itself, and the ones it sends a worker (README.md, Verbs the daemon adds).

oneOf.title: workerList
oneOf.description: The workers, one record each: <core> is always -: the setting placement pins a worker to the whole set of audio cores, never to one core of its own, so no worker has a core to report; <pool> is on for a worker started with the CLAP thread pool (the pin of its plugin carries pool=cores, and no other plugin shares the worker), qualified for every other.

oneOf.title: instanceInfo
oneOf.description: Where an instance lives and what it has cost.

oneOf.title: supervisorReset
oneOf.description: Re-arm the storm bound and the backoff of a given-up placement: [<worker> | all].

oneOf.title: quarantineClear
oneOf.description: Let a quarantined instance go back where its placement says: <instance> | all.

oneOf.title: policySet
oneOf.description: The placement of an add that says default: <format | *> own | pool:<name>.

oneOf.title: poolConfig
oneOf.description: The instances a pool holds before a sibling opens: <name> <max_instances>.

oneOf.title: workerEnv
oneOf.description: The cpu list and the nice value of the workers of a format, at spawn and on the ones running: <format | *> <cpu-list | -> <nice | ->.

oneOf.title: pinSet
oneOf.description: The pin of one plugin: <uri> <path>=<sha256>[,<path>=<sha256>...] <scheme>:<sha256> [verdict=<verdict>].

oneOf.title: pinClear
oneOf.description: Forget the pin of one plugin, or of every one: <uri> | all.

oneOf.title: pinReload
oneOf.description: Read the pin_file and the pins_dir files again and put the pins in at once; running instances keep running.

oneOf.title: pinChanged
oneOf.description: The sync's notice that the pin file was rewritten: the same as pin_reload, with or without the <uri> [files|layout] of the pin_changed event.

oneOf.title: pinAccept
oneOf.description: Under pin_mode first-use, take the plugin's files as they are now as its pin: <uri>.

oneOf.title: pinLayout
oneOf.description: Sent by the daemon to a worker that checks layouts, after it accepted an add whose layout pin is unknown: the layout the worker found after init.

oneOf.title: lv2WorkerSet
oneOf.description: The worker of one LV2 plugin, for its adds from now on: <uri> <mod-host | omx-clap-host | ->.

oneOf.title: chain
oneOf.description: The instances, in this order, are one chain run in one worker: <chain> <instance> [<instance> ...]; a worker that runs chains in one client is sent the line with the members it holds.

oneOf.title: chainClear
oneOf.description: Forget the chain: each member goes to a worker of its own.

oneOf.title: chainGet
oneOf.description: Read a chain back: its worker, its members in the declared order, and the members its worker runs now.

oneOf.title: descriptorGet
oneOf.description: The scanned descriptor of the plugin, answered from descriptor_dir: <uri>.

oneOf.title: panelGet
oneOf.description: The panel the plugin publishes, answered from descriptor_dir: <uri>.

oneOf.title: presetList
oneOf.description: The plugin's presets, the ones its preset discovery or its bundle lists.

oneOf.title: presetGet
oneOf.description: One preset, 0 to count - 1: the key preset_load takes for it, and its name.

oneOf.title: presetShow
oneOf.description: What a load of the preset would apply, on one line of JSON: the preset file's document with each state body's bytes replaced by its decoded size, or for a listed preset its name, loadKey and location. The instance form; mod-host's preset_show <uri> is its own verb.

oneOf.title: historyGet
oneOf.description: What the daemon kept of one plugin on this host class, for the binary its pin holds now: <uri>. The history is one word, digest=<sha256>,class=<host class>,crashed=<0|1>,raises_xruns=<0|1> and then every key=value of PLUGIN_HOSTD_HISTORY_KEYS, joined by commas; - when the plugin has no record or no pin, unavailable while the history file is blocked.

oneOf.title: historyClear
oneOf.description: Delete the history of one plugin, every binary and host class, or all of it: <uri> | all. Refused while the history file is blocked.

oneOf.title: plan
oneOf.description: The instances, in signal order, are planned into the fewest workers their pins and costs allow: <chain> <instance> [<instance> ...]. Each run of consecutive members that may share a worker becomes a chain of place chain:<chain>.<k>, the others stay alone in a worker of their own; the reply names the segments in order, the members of a segment joined by commas and the segments by semicolons, then the same with each member replaced by -, the core field, which the setting placement leaves empty because it pins a worker to the whole set of audio cores and not to one core. With the setting grouping off the plan is answered and kept, and nothing moves.

oneOf.title: planGet
oneOf.description: Read the last plan of a chain back: its segments as plan answered them, then the reason of each member that has one (a word of PLUGIN_HOSTD_GROUPING_REASONS, plan-refused followed by the refusal's number), instance:reason joined by commas, - for none, then the cores of the members as plan answers them.

oneOf.title: planClear
oneOf.description: Forget the plan: each member goes to a worker of its own, as chain_clear does.

oneOf.title: estimate
oneOf.description: What a chain of these plugins would cost at a rate and a quantum, read from the qualification records with no plugin loaded: <rate> <quantum> <uri> [<uri> ...], the uris as add takes them, in signal order. The reply is the latency in frames (each member's measured latency, else its declared one, added up), the CPU as percent of one core's cycle (each member's median nanoseconds per sample times the rate, added up), the RAM in bytes (the Pss each member's worker had running alone on this host class, added up; - unless every member has one), the workers plan would place the members in, and how many members have no figure at that rate and quantum; then each of those as its position in the line, from 0, and its code (noRecord, noCell or unknownPlugin), joined by commas, - for none. The latency and the CPU add up only the members that have a figure. Then the memory: what the workers hold now in bytes (- when one cannot be read), what the members would add in bytes from the qualification records, what instances of one plugin share counted once in a segment (- when no member has a figure), the host's ram_budget_mb in bytes (- when none is set), and how many members have no such figure. Last the host's insert verdict on the last uri, the candidate, added to the chain the others make: a word of ESTIMATE_VERDICTS and the word of ESTIMATE_REASONS that gave it (the domain estimate), the first that holds in this order: the candidate's unknownPlugin refuses, its noRecord or noCell is not measured; the CPU over the real-time admission ceiling of one core, the memory used and added over the budget, another member's code, a memory figure missing each warns; else recommend, within. A consumer shows the two words and computes no verdict.

oneOf.title: nodeLabel
oneOf.description: Labels a hosted node for graph clients: <instance> [<label word> ...], answered resp 0. The label is the rest of the line, its words joined by one space, and the node's pretty-name becomes the labelled form of node_metadata (<label>: <plugin name> (<instance>)); no words clears the label, and the pretty-name is the plain form again. The node's client name stays effect_<instance>. The label lasts as long as the instance: plugin-hostd keeps it and sets it again on a respawned worker, and remove ends it. A label over PHD_NODE_LABEL_MAX bytes or not UTF-8 is refused (-545) and the node keeps its label; an instance with no node is refused (-3); a host that does not serve the verb answers invalid operation (plugin-hostd#35).

oneOf.title: descriptionGet
oneOf.description: The key a client reads the plugin's description by in the descriptions store (omx-panel docs/descriptions-store.md): <uri>, answered <sha256> <format> <uri> <layer>, the layer that holds it; -529 when no layer holds it, -530 while its ask runs.

PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_LIBRARY_VERBS.description: The verbs of the protocol itself, which the library answers for any host that registers them: hello (protocol_add_hello), the bulk verbs, which host_dispatch_register() answers over the host's backend, and the curve verbs, which host_dispatch_register_curve() answers over it and the rate the host gives. A client that never sends one is answered exactly as mod-host answers it.

oneOf.title: hello
oneOf.description: Open a session: <version> [<extension> ...], the protocol version the client speaks and the extensions it asks for. The reply is the daemon's protocol version and, of the extensions asked for, the ones it grants, in the order of PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_EXTENSIONS; an extension the daemon does not know is not granted and is no error. Each hello replaces what the one before it granted, and a new connection starts with none. -902 for a version that is not a whole number of 1 or more, and nothing changes.

oneOf.title: paramGetMany
oneOf.description: The values of several parameters of one instance in one line: <instance> <symbol> [<symbol> ...], each value as param_get writes it, in the order asked. A symbol the instance does not have refuses the whole line with param_get's code (-103), an instance that does not exist with -3, and no value is answered then.

oneOf.title: paramSetMany
oneOf.description: Several parameters of one instance in one line, all or nothing: <instance> <symbol> <value> [<symbol> <value> ...]. Every pair is checked before any is set: a symbol the instance does not have (-103), an instance that does not exist (-3), a value that is not a number or a pair with no value (-902). The first pair refused refuses the line, answered resp <code> <position> with the pair's position from 1, and no value is set. Should the host refuse a value as it sets it, the values set before it are set back, and the line is refused the same way.

oneOf.title: curveBind
oneOf.description: Bind a display of an instance's panel description to the instance's parameters, for curve_points: <instance> <display> clear, or <instance> <display> <kind> <family> <term> [<term> ...], the display's index in the description, its kind (eq_response, transfer_curve or time_response) and family (eq for an eq_response; delay or reverb for a time_response; any other for a transfer_curve), and each term <role>[.<index>]=<symbol>[:<unit>][@<shape>|<shape>...] as the description gives the role: the parameter that plays it, its unit, for a band_type the band shape of each choice value from 0 (a band_freq takes one shape, the band's fixed shape), and for a head filter's slope the dB per octave of each choice value from 0 (@12|24), the role's declared enumeration. The terms are added to the display's binding, a term of a role and index already bound replacing it; a line of another kind or family starts the binding again, and clear drops it. Every term is checked before any is kept: an instance that does not exist (-3), a symbol it does not have (-103), a family the kind is not drawn for (-536), a unit the role does not take (-538), a term the grammar does not take (-902). The binding lives with the instance and goes with its remove; it is never saved.

oneOf.title: curvePoints
oneOf.description: The points of a bound display: <instance> <display> <points>, the grid points asked for. Each bound symbol's value is read from the instance as it is now and the instance's rate with it, and omx-dsp's omx_curve_points_marked draws them: an eq_response x in Hz and y in dB, the bands' anchors added (three a drawn band), a transfer_curve input dB to output dB, a time_response of a reverb its decay envelope, time in ms to level in dB (no point at mix 0), and of a delay its taps. The reply is the count, the marks (one word) and each point x,y, x to four significant digits and y to 0.01 dB, ascending in x; at most curve_points_max (omx-dsp's CURVE_POINTS_MAX, 256) points. A delay has no point but taps, which follow the count as `stems <count> <t>,<dB>,<shade>,<leg> ...`: each tap's time in ms (four significant digits), its level in dB relative to the impulse (0.01), its brightness 0..1 (0.001) and the leg it lands on (both, left or right, omx-dsp's CURVE_LEGS), in time order, the dry tap first. The marks are each drawn eq_response band whose origin is not user, `<freq>,<depth>,<q>,<origin>`, its frequency and depth at the same precision as a point, its Q to 0.01 and its origin, the word omx-dsp's OMX_CURVE_ORIGIN_WORDS spells for it (CURVE_ORIGINS, omx-dsp's curve domain), joined by `;`, in band order; `-` when there is none, as for a host that gives every bound term the origin user, a transfer_curve and a time_response. The origin comes from the host's backend alone. A delay whose sync is on needs the host's tempo, which this library is not given: it is -537, never a guessed tempo. A display with no binding, or a binding without a term the model needs (-537); a band shape or slope, a reverb algorithm or a delay division with no closed form (-536); points outside 2 to curve_points_max, the anchors counted (-539); a value that is not finite or an instance not running at a rate (-542).

oneOf.title: monitorOutputOff
oneOf.description: Ends the monitor monitor_output set on an output: <instance> <symbol>, answered resp 0, and the output's feedback lines stop. A monitor ends with the connection that set it, so a controller that disconnects leaves none behind, and only the connection that set a monitor ends it earlier: an output this connection did not monitor (never monitored, monitored by an earlier connection, already ended, or its instance removed) is refused (-543), and a line that is not an instance and a symbol, or a host that does not serve the verb, is refused (-902). The output's ledger line goes with the monitor, so a respawn of the instance does not replay it.

PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_SHARED_VERBS.description: The verbs omx-clap-host and plugin-hostd both answer by instance, and the layout pin and the chain plugin-hostd send its worker before an add: declared once, rendered for both hosts.

oneOf.title: trackInfo
oneOf.description: The strip's name, colour and kind: <instance> <name> <#RRGGBB | -> [bus | return | master]; a string word is at most 255 bytes of UTF-8 with no control character, and any other word is -902. A CLAP plugin reads them through clap.track-info.

oneOf.title: remotePages
oneOf.description: The plugin's remote-control pages, from clap.remote-controls; 0 for a plugin that has none.

oneOf.title: remotePageGet
oneOf.description: One page, 0 to count - 1: its section and name as quoted words, and each slot the symbol param_set takes, - for an empty one; -902 for a page that is not one.

oneOf.title: paramInfo
oneOf.description: What a parameter's value means: its unit, its scale (linear, log or stepped), its range, default and step, and the symbol it keeps across hosts and versions.

oneOf.title: pinExpect
oneOf.description: The layout pin <scheme>:<sha256> the next add of the instance checks after init and before activate; plugin-hostd sends it to a worker of a format that checks layouts, and refuses the add with any other answer than resp 0.

oneOf.title: chainExpect
oneOf.description: The chain the next add of the instance joins, at its end, in the head's client: no client of its own is opened or activated. That add answers invalidOperation, and nothing of the plugin stays, when the host runs no such chain or the plugin is not as wide as the head's output; plugin-hostd sends it for each member after a chain's first, and a worker that refuses the verb gets the add and the chain line instead.

oneOf.title: noteInput
oneOf.description: Whether the instance takes notes: the name of its note input on its worker's jack client, - for a plugin that takes none.

oneOf.title: noteOn
oneOf.description: Play a key: <instance> <channel> <key> <velocity>, channel 0 to 15, key 0 to 127, velocity 1 to 127, a MIDI note on at the start of the worker's next cycle; -902 for a word out of its range.

oneOf.title: noteOff
oneOf.description: Release a key: <instance> <channel> <key> <velocity>, velocity 0 to 127, a MIDI note off; answered as note_on is.

oneOf.title: allNotesOff
oneOf.description: Release every key of every channel, MIDI's all notes off (controller 123) on each; answered as note_on is.

oneOf.title: propertyList
oneOf.description: The instance's file and text properties (org.openmixer.properties/1, #15): how many; 0 for a plugin that offers none or whose table broke a rule at load.

oneOf.title: propertyInfo
oneOf.description: One property, 0 to count - 1: its symbol, its kind (path or string), its access (rw, w or r) and its name as a quoted-escaped word; -106 for an index that is not one.

oneOf.title: propertyGet
oneOf.description: The value the plugin holds now for the property of that symbol, as a quoted-escaped word ("" when unset); -107 for one that is not readable.

oneOf.title: propertySet
oneOf.description: Set the property of that symbol to the quoted-escaped value: it reaches the plugin at its next block; -107 for one that is not writable, -108 for a value too large, not UTF-8 or a path that is not absolute, -109 when the instance's ring is full (send it again).

PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_CLAP_HOST_VERBS.description: The verbs omx-clap-host adds to mod-host's protocol for itself: what a controller reads of an instance's ports, window, note counters and the CPU idle hold.

oneOf.title: audioPorts
oneOf.description: The instance's audio ports, inputs first and each side's main port first, each with the JACK ports that carry it; dry while the instance passes its input through.

oneOf.title: hideExternalUi
oneOf.description: Hide the plugin's own window that show_external_ui showed.

oneOf.title: idleHold
oneOf.description: The CPU idle hold as it stands; idle_hold <off | microseconds> changes its target at once and answers resp 0.

oneOf.title: noteDrops
oneOf.description: The note events the instance's blocks had no room for, of them the releases, the sysex past a block's pool, and the messages no dialect of the plugin carries.

oneOf.title: noteOutDrops
oneOf.description: The plugin's note output counters: the events the ring had no room for, those with no MIDI form, and the messages midi_out had no room for.

PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_EXTENSIONS.description: The extensions hello can grant, each a word a client names after its version. A session that was granted none is answered as mod-host answers it.

oneOf.title: tags
oneOf.description: request tags: a line may start with @<tag>, and its answer then starts with the same @<tag>

oneOf.title: errors
oneOf.description: error words: a refusal resp <n> is followed by the stable word of its code, reply.<group>.<reason>, when the protocol declares one

oneOf.title: seq
oneOf.description: event sequence numbers: every feedback line starts with #<n>, 1 for the first after this hello and one more for each, so a gap is a missed line
